issues.description: Systemic violation of KL-07: The 'ssr: false' directive is missing from page routes (app/(tools)/.../page.tsx) for tools utilizing browser-only APIs.
issues.reproduction_steps: 1. Inspect page.tsx for tools like Internet Speed Test or Typing Speed Test. 2. Observe direct imports of client components or missing ssr: false in dynamic() calls within the page route.
issues.expected: KL-07 mandates that the 'ssr: false' directive MUST be in the page route, not hidden in child wrappers or missing entirely.
issues.actual: Most tools either lack the directive entirely or hide it in a *Wrapper.tsx component, violating the strict architectural guardrail.
issues.root_cause: Inconsistent application of KL-07 during tool development.
issues.user_impact: Potential hydration mismatches, flickering on load, and initialization failures for tools relying on browser-specific APIs.
issues.fix_recommendation: Move dynamic() with ssr: false directly into the app/(tools)/[category]/[id]/page.tsx files.

issues.description: Widespread violation of Design System tokens: Hardcoded Tailwind colors (slate, indigo, orange, etc.) used in several tools.
issues.reproduction_steps: Search for 'slate-' or 'indigo-' in src/features/. Identified in: Command Cheat Sheet, Hash Map Visualizer, Currency Converter (Debug), Calendar, Pomodoro Timer, Image SEO, and PrivacyBadge.
issues.expected: All visual primitives must use the design token system defined in src/theme/ (e.g., surface, border, text-1).
issues.actual: Many tools use hardcoded Tailwind colors, causing visual inconsistency between tools and broken theme support for those specific elements.
issues.root_cause: Legacy code or copy-pasted components that weren't migrated to KV tokens.
issues.user_impact: Subtle visual inconsistencies and potential readability issues in dark mode or high-contrast themes.
issues.fix_recommendation: Refactor identified components to use KV tokens (e.g., replace bg-slate-900 with bg-surface or bg-bg).

issues.description: Redundant and violating Blob URL management in src/utils.ts.
issues.reproduction_steps: Check src/utils.ts lines 180-195. Observe a standalone createObjectURL implementation.
issues.expected: KL-01 mandates zero raw URL.createObjectURL usage outside the central blobManager or useObjectUrlManager.
issues.actual: src/utils.ts provides a redundant createObjectURL function that is still used by several utilities (calculator-utils.ts, zip.ts), fragmenting memory management.
issues.root_cause: Redundant utility functions created outside the primary blobManager architecture.
issues.user_impact: Increased risk of memory leaks as the central blobManager cannot track or revoke URLs created via src/utils.ts.
issues.fix_recommendation: Deprecate createObjectURL in src/utils.ts and migrate all callers to use blobManager.

issues.description: Missing ssr: false for Financial Freedom Calculator despite Canvas usage.
issues.reproduction_steps: Open app/(tools)/calculators/financial-freedom-calculator/page.tsx. Observe direct import of Client component.
issues.expected: Tools using browser-only APIs like Canvas must be loaded with ssr: false.
issues.actual: The tool is loaded synchronously on the server, relying on useEffect guards inside the component which is less efficient than dynamic(ssr: false).
issues.fix_recommendation: Wrap the client component in dynamic() with ssr: false.
